name: Gribble Gap at WCHRS flume
status: PRE-REGISTRATION DRAFT - freeze on commit, never alter after

gauge.rating: factory stage-discharge; suspected usable ceiling ~185 L/s (two independent record peaks at 184.9 and 183.8 L/s) - CONFIRM WITH WCHRS
gauge.ceiling_evidence: Record max 6.53 cfs (184.9 L/s) over 3.7 yr vs regression Q2yr=14.9 cfs (PI90 8.1-27.3). A 3.7-yr record should contain ~1-2 events at/above Q2yr; instead two independent events terminate at 6.49-6.53 cfs (0.6% apart). Strongly consistent with flume rating/overtopping ceiling near 185 L/s; peaks above ~6.5 cfs likely censored. Treat large observed peaks as lower bounds in Mode C.

streamstats.snap_note: snapped ~500 ft downstream of flume, at/near Long Branch confluence; DA slightly overstates flume catchment
streamstats.DA_adopted_rationale: Gannon published 43 ha for the flume itself; StreamStats +8.4% attributable to downstream snap. Model runs use 0.166; StreamStats characteristics assumed representative of both.

model_parameters.CN2_method: HSG-weighted composite, woods good condition (A=30,B=55), NLCD developed 21-24 (A=57,B=65), shrub (A=35,B=56); weights = NLCD cover x SSURGO HSG fractions
model_parameters.Tc_wet_method: roster-convention scaling (x62/36, per CC-LB-171 Kirpich:NRCS-wet ratio) - provisional pending segmental TR-55
model_parameters.Tc_resolution_note: Tc ~ one 10-min data step; observed hydrograph peaks are 1-2 samples wide (e.g. 2018-05-31), consistent with Tc<=10 min. Peak-capture error at 10-min sampling is a recognized uncertainty on observed peaks.

flow_statistics.source: Peak Southeast US NC 2023-5006; LowFlow/Annual SIR 2026-5021; Bieger 2015 bankfull; exported 2026-07-29
flow_statistics.lowflow_annual_extrapolated: DA 0.18 below 0.3 sqmi min limit for SIR 2026-5021 low/annual/monthly equations

calibration_plan.mode: C (ad-hoc unrated nested catchment, k_event_raw vs raw TR-55/UH peak)
calibration_plan.calibration_set: 38 events >25 L/s, 2015-08-13 to 2019-04-17 (see gribble_gap_event_inventory_2015_2019.csv), rain from cucn7 archive (valley point gauge, ~2.5 mi, orographic caveat) pending WCHRS 15-min gauges
calibration_plan.holdout: Hurricane Helene (2024-09-26/27) - excluded from all calibration; WCHRS discharge record is the blind test target
calibration_plan.declared: calibration/holdout split declared before any WCHRS Helene data received

provenance.public_data_citation: Gannon, J. (2019). Gribble Gap Watershed Discharge, HydroShare, http://www.hydroshare.org/resource/156bed7f9b984677ad617fd071a99a33, CC-BY 4.0

bankfull_bieger_2015.note: BlueRidge_P DA below its 5.46 sqmi applicability floor; AppHighlands_D within range
